b: In this passage we see that God delights in the peace of His servant. This is a very encouraging message, because peace is not only a feeling but a posture for living.

In our lives we often face much pressure, difficulty, and challenge. Sometimes we may feel wronged, feeling that we have been misunderstood or treated unfairly. But when we trust God and hand these wrongs over to Him, He will surely vindicate us. This is what the Scripture means by those who favor my righteous cause. God is a righteous God; He sees everything and will surely bring justice for us. A young man named Derong met with many challenges and pressures at work. Every day he felt crushed and breathless, wronged with nowhere to appeal. He began to doubt whether he could cope with these difficulties.

But when Derong decided to give all of this to God, a peace began to rise in his heart. He knew that even if he could not change his circumstances, God is the One who delights in the peace of His servant. He began to concentrate on his work and handed everything over to God to handle.

After a while Derong unexpectedly received an opportunity for promotion, and at work he began to gain more peace and joy. His colleagues saw the change in him and began to praise God’s greatness and the wonderful things He was doing in Derong’s life.

This story tells us that when we hand our wrongs and pressures over to God, He will surely vindicate us. He delights in the peace of His servant and is willing to show His abundant grace in our lives.
So let us entrust everything to God each day, believing in His justice and grace. When we live out such faith and hope, we will experience the true peace and joy He gives.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God continue to show His wonderful works in your life, so that you can enjoy His peace and joy in every difficulty. Amen!

v: “Now acquaint yourself with him, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
b: In this passage God reminds us that only by knowing Him can we have true peace. This is a very important message, because in this world many people are searching for peace and happiness. Yet they often fix their eyes on possessions, status, and achievement, and overlook the one God who can bring true peace.

There was a man named Sam. From childhood he pursued money and success, always hoping to have a place in society. He worked hard and kept chasing higher status and more wealth. But as his career succeeded, he found himself more and more unhappy and spiritually empty.

One day Sam met a Christian friend, who shared the peace and joy he had experienced in coming to know God. These words deeply touched Sam’s heart, and he began to seek more knowledge of God. Through reading the Bible, praying, and attending church, Sam gradually began to know God.

As his relationship with God grew closer, he found that his heart gained true peace. No longer chasing material satisfaction, Sam began to understand that true happiness and peace come from God’s love and grace. He learned to live by relying on God’s will and was no longer troubled by outside pressure and ambition. Sam’s life underwent a complete transformation. He became a kind and loving person, and with his life he bore witness to God’s grace.

Dear family, like Sam, when we know God and build a close relationship with Him, we too can experience inner peace and joy. Whatever difficulty or challenge we face, God’s love and protection are always at our side. When we let go of the pursuit of worldly things and turn to seek God’s heart and ways, we will find that true peace and happiness are in the presence of God.
So let us come to know God together and bring His love and peace into our lives. When we walk with God and pursue His will, we will find that blessing will come to us as well.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive peace and blessing on the road of knowing God and become a witness to others. Amen!

v: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of good, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
b: This passage reminds us that we have good news to announce, and this good news is not only peace but also salvation. When we proclaim this good news, we also proclaim the coming of God’s Kingdom, God’s sovereignty, and God’s servant, Jesus Christ.

Imagine a man walking on a steep mountain path. His steps are light and steady, like a dancer whose every touch of the ground carries endless beauty. This scene reminds us of the one described in the Bible who brings peace and salvation, whose steps are likewise beautiful and firm.

Let us return to real life. In this world full of hardship and challenge, can we also become people who bring peace and salvation? There will always be many difficulties and pressures in life, and we may feel lost and helpless, but it is precisely at such times that we need to remember this passage.

We can pass on peace and salvation with a warm word of greeting, a sincere act of care, or a helping hand when someone is in need. Sometimes a smile or a word of encouragement can let others feel God’s love and compassion. Like the man on the mountain path, our steps too should be full of faith and hope, bringing others the good news of peace and salvation.

So let us carry peace and salvation every day with steps of kindness and love. Whether among family, friends, colleagues, or strangers, we can be God’s messengers and bring His peace and salvation to everyone.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. As you pass on peace and salvation, may you also experience God’s grace and blessing. Amen!

v: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;
b: In this verse we are reminded to put on the gospel of peace and make it the shoes for our journey. This is a very beautiful picture, teaching us that when we go through hardship and trials in life, we can move forward with faith and hope. There was a famous marathon runner. In an important race this runner fell, but he did not give up. Instead, with a peaceful heart and firm conviction, he got up again and kept running. He told himself that although he had fallen, he would not stop moving forward, because within him was the gospel of peace.

Each of us may meet setbacks and difficulties in life, but it is through faith and hope that we can get up, like that marathon runner, and keep going. The gospel of peace is our protector in hardship, giving us strength and comfort.

Although we live in a world full of strife and turmoil, when we put on the gospel of peace, it becomes the shoes for our walk and keeps our souls from being disturbed by the outside world. It is like having a pair of sturdy and comfortable shoes on life’s journey, so that we can step forward freely, not troubled by fear and worry.

Dear family, may you put on the gospel of peace every day and let it be the shoes for your journey. Whatever difficulties and challenges you face, believe God’s word and walk steadily forward. May you experience God’s protection and blessing, and with faith, hope, and love, be the light and salt of this world.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find strength and comfort in the gospel of peace. Amen!

v: Behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will heal them; and I will reveal to them abundance of prosperity and truth.
b: In this passage God shows us His great power and boundless lovingkindness. He promises to bring health and healing to the city and to give its people abundant peace and truth. What an encouraging message! Whatever difficulty or pain we face now, God’s grace and lovingkindness can heal our souls and restore our peace.

We may face all kinds of challenges, such as health problems, turmoil in family relationships, or pressure at work, and these can leave us feeling powerless and discouraged. But when we entrust everything to God, He will surely bring us health and healing. Just as a doctor can heal our bodies, God can heal our souls and pour His peace and truth into our hearts.

Let us think: what is true peace? It is not only physical comfort and being free from care, but a deep inner stillness that keeps us connected to God no matter the circumstances. Like taking shelter in a sturdy house during a storm, God’s peace protects us and enables us to stand firm in adversity.

A young woman had gone through a series of setbacks and disappointments in her life. Her family had broken apart and her career was in trouble, and she felt lost and despairing. But in her darkest hour she met a Christian of firm faith and loving heart, who said to her, “God is not only your lifeboat, He is also your harbor. In Him you can find peace and comfort.”

That woman began to seek God. She entrusted herself fully to Him and spent time each day reading the Bible and praying. Although her troubles did not change immediately, she gradually discovered inner peace and joy. Through the change in her life, God also began to reveal His glory.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s healing and abundant peace in every difficulty and challenge. When you feel helpless and discouraged, remember that we have a God who loves you and is willing to help you. Trust His promise and seek His face, and He will surely bring you health and healing. May you experience God’s grace and abundant peace every day. Amen!

v: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
b: In this passage we see that God gives us a peace that surpasses understanding, a peace we find hard to comprehend but which is truly real. Through Christ Jesus we can keep our hearts at peace.
In our lives we often face much pressure and difficulty. We may feel discouraged, worried, or afraid. Yet when we have the peace that God gives, we can stay calm and steady in any circumstance.

There was a girl named Anna, a university student. She studied very hard but felt great pressure. She worried about her grades, about finding a job in the future, and about her relationships. One day Anna met a teacher of firm faith, who told her about the peace God gives us.

The teacher shared with Anna the story of Jesus calming the storm. The disciples were terrified as the wind and waves battered the boat, but Jesus was sleeping peacefully. The disciples woke Jesus, and when He woke up, He calmed the wind and the waves. Anna understood that when we are with Jesus, we can find peace and comfort in the storm and experience Jesus calming the storm.

This story deeply moved Anna, and she began to learn to entrust her pressure and worries to God. Every morning she spent time with God in prayer and Bible reading. She learned to let go of control and to believe that God would arrange the best future for her.

Anna’s life began to change. Although she still faced pressure and difficulty, she had a peace within, knowing that God would guard her heart and her thoughts. This peace did not come from her own strength, but from her connection with Christ.

Dear family, I believe everyone will meet difficulty and challenge in life. But let us remember that the peace God gives us is beyond anything we can imagine. Whether we face a storm or pressure, when we are connected to Christ, we can find peace and strength in the midst of it.
Let us learn, like Anna, to hand our worries and fears over to God and to trust in His blessing.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. In every challenge and difficulty, may you feel the surpassing peace God gives you, and may you believe that He will guard your heart and your thoughts. Amen!

v: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
b: In this passage God reminds us to let the peace of Christ rule in our hearts. This is a strong call, telling us that whatever difficulty or challenge we face, we can have the peace of Christ. This peace is a gift from the Holy Spirit and the glory of our being made one with Christ.
Have you ever thought about what in life can bring us true peace? We might think of a story:

Once there was a gardener who worked in his garden every day, caring for all kinds of plants. He tended each flower and plant with great care and helped them grow strong. One day he planted a tiny seed and waited expectantly and attentively for it to grow.

But the seed met with many difficulties. It was blown away by the wind, soaked by the rain, and gnawed by insects. Yet the seed did not give up. It worked hard to take root in the soil and to absorb sunlight and water.

In the end the seed grew into a sturdy tree. Its branches and leaves were lush, its flowers bloomed, and it drew many butterflies and birds. The tree brought the gardener immense joy, because he saw that his hard work had borne rich fruit.

This story tells us that the peace of Christ is like this. When we plant our faith in God’s word and keep working to live out Christ’s love and truth in our daily lives, we can have this peace. Whatever difficulty or challenge we face, we can believe that God is with us and gives us His peace.
So let us keep a thankful heart every day, with gratitude and obedience toward God. When we let the peace of Christ rule in our hearts, we can find true peace through the ups and downs of life.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the peace of Christ every day. Wherever you are and whatever difficulty you face, may you live out Christ’s love and truth with a thankful and obedient heart. Amen!
